ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar will explore theory, policy and practice of community engagement through cases studies, and observing actual planning and decision-making process at different scales and contexts. Students will learn about different tools and strategies that bring people together, particularly in low-income neighborhoods and culturally diverse cities. Collectively we will design a participatory process for a local organization. Throughout the semester we will grapple with the myriad of challenges and dilemmas faced by nonprofit advocates, community activists and equity-oriented public planners. Graduate students only.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Urban & Regional Planning department.
